result.title: Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action
result.summary: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.

AI.brief_summary: 发布 6,499 个艺术家制作的 3D 场景数据集，含精细几何、PBR 材质与对象级、部件级语义标注，用于逆渲染、3D 重建、场景理解与移动操作的联合监督训练，并提出一个评测 VLA 模型抓取放置及抓取位置的基准。
